title: GARY DELANEY
tickerText:
GARY DELANEY IS ONE OF BRITAIN’S MOST CELEBRATED STAND-UP COMEDIANS, A MASTER OF LIGHTNING-FAST ONE-LINERS, OUTRAGEOUS PUNCHLINES AND BRILLIANTLY WICKED HUMOUR.

AN AWARD-WINNING COMEDY POWERHOUSE, GARY’S LAST TOUR SPANNED AN INCREDIBLE TWO AND A HALF YEARS AND 378 SHOWS, PROVING HIS PHENOMENAL POPULARITY WITH AUDIENCES ACROSS THE COUNTRY.

HIS LEGENDARY NINE MINUTES OF ONE-LINERS ON LIVE AT THE APOLLO HAS ATTRACTED OVER 60 MILLION ONLINE VIEWS, CEMENTING HIS REPUTATION AS ONE OF THE SHARPEST COMEDIC MINDS IN THE BUSINESS.

A REGULAR FAVOURITE ON MOCK THE WEEK, GARY HAS ALSO WRITTEN FOR NUMEROUS TELEVISION PROGRAMMES AND FELLOW COMEDIANS.

OFTEN DESCRIBED AS BRITAIN’S MOST QUOTED COMEDIAN, HIS RELENTLESS STREAM OF PERFECTLY CRAFTED JOKES LEAVES AUDIENCES ROARING WITH LAUGHTER.

SHARP, FEARLESS, UNASHAMEDLY RUDE AND ABSOLUTELY HILARIOUS.

“I LAUGHED AND I LAUGHED AND I LAUGHED…” – THE TIMES
